patch.summary: Gamma cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Gamma pricing is plan-gated across 2 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Trial/free path present in researched plans

blocks.title: Gamma plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, image generation · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Plus
lines.description: Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.heading: Gamma cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Gamma against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, image generation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Not a full LLM assistant — presentation/doc generation is the core job. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
